Level 1: Summarised: Brief paragraph covering challenges; opportunities; expected benefits; and how features address them.
Level 2: Structured: Organised sections mapping each challenge to specific features and expected outcomes; with logical rationale for each value claim.
Level 3: Elaborated: Full narrative with case studies; worked financial examples; and evidence demonstrating value realisation for each mapping.
Level 4: Actionable: Complete with value-capture templates; outcome-tracking dashboards; and reusable business-case frameworks ready for adaptation.

Level 1: Summarised: Brief identification of security risks; compliance requirements; legal liabilities; and mitigation approaches.
Level 2: Structured: Categorised risk assessment with compliance mappings; prioritised mitigation strategies; and defined responsibility assignments.
Level 3: Elaborated: Detailed risk scenarios with behavioural response guides; compliance evidence chains; and worked mitigation examples.
Level 4: Actionable: Ready-to-use compliance audit checklists; automated security posture checks; and complete policy templates.

Level 1: Summarised: Brief profiles of key personas covering their needs; interests; expected value; and engagement approach.

Level 4: Actionable: Interactive persona-specific onboarding templates; stakeholder alignment worksheets; and dynamic engagement trackers.
